title: Tp rod datapack
description: This datapack works like a orbital strike canon fishing rod but except when you right click it will tp you to the specific coordinates. To change the coordinates go Tp_rod->data->teleport->function->rc.mcfunction and change the where it says tp @s
body:
This data pack works same as most of the orbital canon data/mods but instead when you right click the rod it will teleport you to specific coordinates

To change go to Tp_rod->data->teleport->function->rc.mcfunction
and then change the numbers where it says tp @s X: Y: Z:
